comparison.objective: Extract a terminal; record secures a bicycle wheel and stand with a U-lock.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade-under-tab release and wire/tool co-withdrawal versus threading a shackle through spokes and around a post, then aligning a crossbar onto two legs simultaneously.
comparison.success_condition: Selective depinning without damage versus a caught, released, still lock enclosing both rim and stand. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The lock assembly tests threading and dual-leg closure, not releasing a recessed retention feature.
